ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ , Bengaluru! 🚦

After the long weekend, inbound traffic is likely to be heavier on Old Madras Road, Outer Ring Road, areas in and around ITPL and Whitefield 

If you’re heading out, please start a little early and maintain lane discipline. Our teams are on the ground doing their best to keep traffic moving.

Your patience and cooperation is highly appreciated!
